Class Loan

java.lang.Object
library.model.Loan
public class Loan extends Object
Represents a loan record for a book issued to a member. Tracks issue date, due date, return date, and loan status.
Author:
Usman

      public Loan(String loanId, String bookId, String memberId, String issueDate, String dueDate)
      Constructs a new Loan with the specified details.
      Parameters:
      loanId - the unique loan ID
      bookId - the ID of the book being loaned

      issueDate - the date the book was issued (yyyy-MM-dd)
      dueDate - the date the book is due (yyyy-MM-dd)

      bookId - the book ID
      memberId - the member ID
      issueDate - the issue date
      dueDate - the due date
      returnDate - the return date (empty if not returned)
